title: 第13章 不你不是后悔而是知道自己要死了第14章 终于来了么老子等你们很久了
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
陈稳在众人的注视下，很快便来到了楚幼微等人的不远处。
呃！
这楚幼微也是天命之子？
就这种废物？
当注意到楚幼微头顶那橙色命魂时，陈稳一时有些怔住了。
不是……前辈。
你不会告诉我，你是盗版货吧。
陈稳不由吐嘈了起来。
“你才是盗版货，你全家都是盗版货呢。”
优雅。
老娘得优雅。
仙红芍自我攻略一番，才道：“你所见都是真实的，证明楚幼微就是天命之子。”
这……好吧。
陈稳无奈一叹。
果然女神都是见过死的物种。
但他这时也不再怀疑，楚幼微就是天命之子了。
楚幼微深吸一口气，壮着胆子直视陈稳，但正好看到陈稳看着她发愣的样子。
下一刻，她便激动了起来。
这舔狗一定是想起了以前的回忆了。
我就说嘛，他爱我爱到骨子里了。

我这才背叛了他一次而已，有什么不能被原谅的，反正我以后都会一心一意侍奉他。
说起来，这还是我付出的要多。
想到这，楚幼微立时坚挺了起来，整个人再次恢复之前骄纵的样子。
现在该是陈稳为取得她原谅，而放低姿态了。
当然了，如果陈稳有诚意。
那她也不是不可以原谅他之前的冒失的。
呼。
这天终于晴了。
我楚幼微也注定成为人上人。
念及此，楚幼微也渐渐扯出一抹笑容来。
秦牧等人也注意到了陈稳的异样，不由相视一眼起来。
仿佛在说。
我靠，还真有这种人才啊。
这下我们可有救了。
想到这，他们齐相激动了起来。
陈稳这时收敛了思绪，但嘴角依旧挂着一抹淡淡的笑意。
楚幼微心绪早已经变了，神色渐渐带上了一抹孤傲。
陈稳再次抬步朝楚幼微逼近，最后在楚幼微的跟前停下。
content_en:
Under the gaze of everyone, Chen Wen quickly arrived not far from Chu Youwei and others.
Well!
Is this Chu Youwei also the son of destiny?
Just this kind of trash?
When he noticed the orange soul above Chu Youwei's head, Chen Wen was stunned for a moment.
Not...senior.
You won't tell me that you are a pirated product.
Chen Wen couldn't help but vomited.
"You are the pirate, and your whole family is a pirate."
Elegant.
I must be elegant.
Xian Hongshao thought about it for a while before saying, "What you saw is true, which proves that Chu Youwei is the son of destiny."
This is... okay.
Chen Wen sighed helplessly.
Sure enough, goddesses are all species that have seen death.
But he no longer doubted that Chu Youwei was the son of destiny.
Chu Youwei took a deep breath and dared to look directly at Chen Wen, but she happened to see Chen Wen looking at her in a daze.
The next moment, she became excited.
This licking dog must have recalled old memories.
Let me just say, he loves me to the core.
I just betrayed him once. There is nothing that cannot be forgiven. Anyway, I will serve him wholeheartedly from now on.
Speaking of which, this is still more than what I paid.
Thinking of this, Chu Youwei immediately became strong, and her whole body returned to its previous arrogant look.
Now it's time for Chen Wen to lower his profile in order to obtain her forgiveness.
Of course, if Chen Wen is sincere.
Then she couldn't forgive him for his previous rashness.
call.
The day finally cleared up.
I, Chu Youwei, am also destined to become a master.
Thinking of this, Chu Youwei gradually smiled.
Qin Mu and others also noticed Chen Wen's strangeness and couldn't help but look at each other.
As if to say.
Damn, there really is such a talent.
Now we are saved.
Thinking of this, they all became excited.
Chen Wen calmed down his thoughts at this time, but there was still a faint smile on his lips.
Chu Youwei's mood had already changed, and his expression gradually took on a hint of arrogance.
Chen Wen once again approached Chu Youwei, and finally stopped in front of Chu Youwei.
